notes: No kb/Work note owns the fix (none found for the phrase order at 85). §1985:VII.4.7.2 prints WRITE record-name-1 [ FROM identifier-1 ], then one optional {BEFORE | AFTER} ADVANCING phrase whose operand is {identifier-2 | integer-1} [LINE | LINES] or {mnemonic-name-1 | PAGE}, then [ AT {END-OF-PAGE | EOP} imperative-statement-1 ], then [ NOT AT {END-OF-PAGE | EOP} imperative-statement-2 ], then [ END-WRITE ]. The superset rules writeStatement and writeBeforeAfter parse it (ADVANCING, LINE/LINES and AT optional words, BEFORE or AFTER required before ADVANCING), BindWrite resolves record-name-1 and binds the phrases, BindAdvancing binds the one operand (a literal through ScreenAdvancingCount, COBOL2365 for a negative, non-integer or nonnumeric literal), and what the later format adds is refused at --std 85: BEFORE AFTER together by VisitWriteBeforeAfter (COBOL0900), FROM literal-1 by VisitRecordFromPhrase (COBOL0871), FILE file-name-1 by DeclinedFilePhrase (COBOL1706), RETRY by VisitRetryPhrase and WITH LOCK by VisitRecordLockPhrase (COBOL0900), INVALID KEY on a sequential file by BindWrite through ScreenForbiddenPhrase (COBOL1720); ADVANCING without BEFORE or AFTER (the witness), a second ADVANCING phrase, PAGE LINES, FROM after ADVANCING, ADVANCING after the END-OF-PAGE phrase, the word RECORD and a second AT END-OF-PAGE are syntax errors (COBOL2269). Probed at 85 and accepted: the bare WRITE, FROM with BEFORE ADVANCING 1 LINE and END-WRITE, AFTER ADVANCING identifier LINES, AFTER 2, BEFORE PAGE, AFTER ADVANCING mnemonic-name, 0 and ZERO lines, AT END-OF-PAGE then NOT AT END-OF-PAGE, EOP without AT. What is NOT implemented is the printed sequence of the two end-of-page phrases: the conditionalPhrases loop and ConditionalPhraseAssociation.Associates / MayAssociate ask only that a phrase is printed by a format and not yet written, with no edition arm for the order, so NOT AT EOP before AT EOP compiles and runs at 85; either order is the 2002 change §2002:F.2 item 33 ("The conditional phrases in the ... WRITE statements may be specified in any order"), which the row's change record names. Same mechanism as the indexed rows 1985-FMT-IX.4.9.2, IX.4.5.2, IX.4.3.2 and IX.4.6.2. The witness is the refusal of WRITE OUT-REC ADVANCING 1 LINE (COBOL2269).

next.reason: §1985:VII.4.7.2 is 'WRITE record-name-1 [FROM identifier-1]', an optional {BEFORE | AFTER} ADVANCING phrase (one of them), then AT END-OF-PAGE before NOT AT END-OF-PAGE, then [END-WRITE]. Its 2023 counterpart is §2023:14.9.51.2 'Format 1 (sequential)', which §2023:14.9.51.3 SR2 ('If the organization of the write file is sequential, format 1 shall be specified') ties to sequential files; every 1985 WRITE fits it with the same meaning. But BEFORE and AFTER are now in choice indicators, so both may be written, limited only by §2023:14.9.51.3 SR17 ('The BEFORE and AFTER phrases shall not both be specified if the PAGE phrase is specified'); the end-of-page phrases may come in either order; and 'FILE file-name-1', 'FROM literal-1', the retry-phrase and WITH [NO] LOCK are added. All are refused by the 1985 format and accepted by 2023, at compile time: CHANGED.
